objectives_fil: Suriin ang aparato at angkop na cuff. Humingi ng pahintulot at ihanda ang tao ayon sa aprubadong checklist. Sukatin at ulitin kung hinihingi ng protocol. Itala ang aktuwal na resulta, yunit, oras at konteksto. Ipaabot sa midwife ang resulta at anumang concern.
Gamitin ang aprubadong paraan at oras ng pagbibilang, itala ang halaga at yunit, at iulat ang concern sa supervisor.
Gamitin ang nasuring pamamaraan at malinis na gamit; itala ang bilang, yunit at oras at iulat ang concern.
Piliin ang angkop na kagamitan, sukatin nang ligtas at may paggalang, at isulat ang tamang yunit.
Piliin ang aprubadong chart, i-plot ang tamang punto at petsa, at ipasuri sa kwalipikadong staff ang interpretasyon.
Hanapin ang tamang lugar ng sukat ayon sa aprubadong checklist, itala ang resulta, at sundin ang referral rule.
Piliin ang adult BMI o age-appropriate chart, ipakita ang kalkulasyon at yunit, at ipa-review ang kahulugan kung kailangan.
objectives_en: Given approved equipment, a fictional client, and a current measurement protocol, take, record, and communicate a BP reading within scope.
Given a watch and training partner, measure, record, and report pulse using the approved protocol.
Given a training partner and thermometer, measure and record both accurately.
Given age-appropriate tools, perform and document measurement with dignity and assistance where needed.
Given fictional child measurements and an approved chart, plot correctly and identify whether qualified review is needed.
Given approved tape and a training model, measure and record MUAC and identify the reviewed referral action.
Given fictional height/weight/age, calculate or plot using the correct approved tool and state a safe follow-up.
summary_fil: Subaybayan ang kalagayang pangkalusugan: 7 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Monitor health status: 7 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
